question: What have you been looking forward to lately?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: “The walking group—I always look forward to our weekly outing. I wash the team bibs, so I’ve got those to get ready as well. It’s easier to lay everything out in the evening when the kitchen’s quiet. Oh, and I put my bus card in the bib bag after the last walk, so that’s one less thing to hunt for. Quite pleased with that little arrangement!”
